patterns.what_worked: Every fix was paired with a reverted-behaviour pin before the suite was called green; the cache pins drive the real INSPECT_READY handler and stage/retry path, and the alias fix was checked against the existing sandboxed 36/36 pins.
patterns.what_was_hard: The cache retry runs through C_Timer, so the tests capture the scheduled callback and drive it; the first freshness pin had to distinguish 'retry owns the entry' from 'retry could not resolve' instead of asserting a single boolean.
patterns.skill_gap: No in-game client is available here, so the portrait-side decision and the final visual pass remain the operator's; the Extras TOC/scan-test red state is deliberately untouched.
